name: Smoking Dragon

features.name: Row Cascade
features.description: The bottom row is removed and everything moves down after each win.

features.name: Epic Wilds
features.description: Double their multiplier on every row cascade.

review:
Smoking Dragon uses a Row Cascade rather than a standard tumble. After any win, the bottom row is removed, everything moves down one row, and a fresh row drops in at the top. The sequence continues while the same win remains, grows or new wins appear.

Wilds can land with additive multipliers from 2x to 100x. Epic Wilds double their multiplier on every row cascade, so one landing near the top can grow a lot as it moves down. The maximum is 10,000x, and the row-by-row movement is easy to follow.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
